A '''Nautolan female Force-user''' lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]] is set during the same time period as [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Galaxies'']]</ref>

==Biography==
[[File:ForceLightning-SOC.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Nautolan throwing Force lightning]]
She was a practitioner of the second form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], known as [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]], and wielded a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="FW">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Flowing Water}}</ref> She was a [[Darksider|follower]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]<ref name="Campaign">She is a Dark Side scenario character in the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|SWG TCG]]''</ref> and at some point during the galaxy-wide conflict, she dueled [[Jedi archaeologist]] [[Rachi Sitra]].<ref name="FW" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Nautolan was adept at conjuring [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="SOCFL">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Force Lightning}}</ref>
